pages: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA VI

notices.title: No GTA VI cheat codes are confirmed yet
notices.body: Rockstar has not revealed whether GTA VI has cheat codes, and none have been tested in the released game. Any code circulating before launch is unverified. The GTA V codes below are shown as a reference for what the format usually looks like.

notices.title: Secrets are catalogued after launch
notices.body: The GTA Wiki has no secrets-and-easter-eggs page for GTA VI yet. This list fills in as locations are found and documented.
